# Versions of: Paying the sources

1 published version of [Paying the sources: the business model behind PrompTugal.news's data, a reader's money flowing back to the sources the reader actually read, worked out in the open and simulated for now, a licence link on every value, a public register of who we read and who we do not, and why a platform built on public data with no lock-in can be a positive loop for everyone who feeds it](../paying-the-sources.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
